out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the back handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC ADDED TOWELS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE PAPER TOWELS ARE ALWAYS SUPPLIED.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: OBSERVED THE DISHWASHING MACHINE WITH NO SANITIZER (CONTAINER WAS EMPTY) AND TESTED AT 0PPM. PIC HAD TO OBTAIN MORE BLEACH DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PIC UNDERSTANDS NO FOOD PREPARATION SHOULD BE DONE IF THERE IS NO SANITIZER PRESENT IN THE FACILITY. PLEASE ENSURE THERE IS ALWAYS EXTRA SANITIZER ONSITE AND THAT STAFF ARE PROPERLY TRAINED ON SANITIZING PROCEDURES.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticide, Conditions of use
violations.observation: Restricted, commercial use pesticides present in the facility are applied by the operator who is not a certified pesticide applicator. OBSERVED RESIDENTIAL PEST CONTROL STORED ON TOP OF THE GREASE TRAP IN BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Because of their toxicity, restricted use pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. PIC REMOVED PEST CONTROL FROM THE ESTABLISHMENT AND UNDERSTANDS RESIDENTIAL PEST CONTROL MAY NOT BE APPLIED IN THE KITCHEN. PLEASE ENSURE ONLY LICENSED PEST CONTROL APPLICATORS LAY PEST CONTROL IN THE KITCHEN.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. NO CFM ONSITE DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. PIC UNDERSTANDS A CFM MUST BE ONSITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE DISHWASHING MACHINE NOT DELIVERING SANITIZER AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PIC SET UP THREE- COMPARTMENT SINK DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS IT SHOULD NOT BE USED TO SANITIZE DISHWARE UNTIL IT HAS BEEN REPAIRED AND IS PROPERLY DELIVERING SANITIZER.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the HANDWASHING SINK NEXT TO THE THREE-COMPARTMENT SINK are leaking.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. PLEASE ENSURE THE LEAK IS REPAIRED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM AT START OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE A CFM IS ON SITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION INCLUDING DURING PREPARATION.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE DRANK COFFEE FROM OPEN CUP AND PLACED OPEN CUP ON PREP COUNTER NEXT TO OTHER EMPLOYEE CUTTING CANTALOUPE.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EMPLOYEE DISCARDED BEVERAGE DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED TURKEY BACON AT 121F ON HOT SERVICE LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO REHEAT FOOD TO 165F.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED SHREDDED CHEESE AT 56F AND SALSA AT 48F IN ICE WELL ON SERVICE LINE. OBSERVED INSUFFICIENT ICE IN WELL TO HAVE FOODS MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES OF 41F OR BELOW.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO ADD ICE TO WELL TO HAVE FOOD CONTAINERS IMMERSED IN ICE.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. OBSERVED POTATOES, BEVERAGES AND FRUIT STORED DIRECTLY ON FLOOR IN BACK KITCHEN AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTIONS STAFF TO REMOVE FOOD ITEMS ONTO SHELVING. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.
